events.text: City renamed Simferopol after Russian annexation of the Crimean Khanate.

evidence.quote: The city was renamed Simferopol in 1784 after the annexation of the Crimean Khanate to the Russian Empire by Catherine II of Russia

events.text: Became administrative centre of the Taurida Governorate.

evidence.quote: In 1802 , Simferopol became the administrative centre of the Taurida Governorate

events.text: Russian Imperial Army reserves and a hospital stationed in city during Crimean War (1854–1856).

evidence.quote: During the Crimean War of 1854–1856 , the Russian Imperial Army reserves and a hospital

events.label: capture
events.text: Red Army captured the city.

evidence.quote: On 13 November 1920 , the Red Army captured the city

events.text: Became capital of the Crimean Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic.

Simferopol became the capital of the Crimean Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic

events.label: prisoner shootings
events.text: Retreating NKVD police shot a number of prisoners in the city.

evidence.quote: Retreating NKVD police shot a number of prisoners on 31 October 1941 in the NKVD building and the citys prison

events.label: occupation began
events.text: Nazi Germany began occupation of the city.

evidence.quote: Simferopol was occupied by Nazi Germany from 1 November 1941 to 13 April 1944

events.label: massacre
events.text: Einsatzgruppen D killed an estimated 14,300 residents, most of them Jews.

evidence.quote: starting 9 December 1941 , the Einsatzgruppen D under Otto Ohlendorfs command killed an estimated 14,300 Simferopol residents
